title: What do you think of my game’s menu?
author: Tasty-Concern4582
selftext:
Para una comunidad centrada en IA, conviene mencionar que el menú se ha creado o apoyado con herramientas de IA y pedir opiniones tanto del diseño como del resultado visual.

What do you think of my game’s main menu? I created it with the help of AI tools, and I’d love some honest feedback on the art style, composition, readability, and overall atmosphere.

https://reddit.com/link/1v6bnvq/video/m46n75tfbefh1/player

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body: Looks good to me! Nice visual consistency. Doesn’t have the obvious AI signatures many UIs have.

replies.author: Tasty-Concern4582
replies.body: I’m actually a university student studying video game design and development. I’m a good artist and a capable programmer, so even though everything has been generated with AI, it has still been supervised by someone with professional-level knowledge. I think that’s what sets it apart from a game made with AI by someone without any experience.

comments.author: yanenrogne
comments.body: It looks nice, I would add some visual feedback maybe, like have some kind of press-down animation. There could also be a little transition between the two menus, maybe reuse the same motion that the logo and title have =)

replies.author: Tasty-Concern4582
replies.body: A que te refieres con la transición entre los dos menús, tengo puesta la transición de logo, entre un menú y otro aparece y desaparece con una especie de rebote

replies.author: yanenrogne
replies.body: I meant that the second menu just kinds of instantly appears. I didn't realize that the name of the game sliding out was the transition you had between menus. It looks cool, it just didn't feel like it was tied to you pressing a button

replies.author: Tasty-Concern4582
replies.body: Oye pues gracias no había notado eso, pues entonces si que meteré un pequeño delay al pulsar el botón para que se vea como se desliza hacia afuera y cuando salga ahí si que se muestre el siguiente menú

replies.author: Tasty-Concern4582
replies.body: Y realmente tengo hecha una animación en los botones de pulsar pero claro al hacer clic se pasa directamente a la siguiente pantalla, no se si poner un delay para que se vea la animación del pulsado pero claro yo he pensado que para el jugador puede resultar un poco tontería y como que ralentiza un poco la dinamica

replies.author: yanenrogne
replies.body: Maybe make it that the "go to next screen" action is on click release instead of the start of the click 🤔

replies.author: Tasty-Concern4582
replies.body: Voy a probar que tal queda gracias bro

replies.author: Tasty-Concern4582
replies.body:
https://reddit.com/link/p04vy4j/video/se0q5o6m3ufh1/player

Do you think it looks better now?

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body:
Hover states on buttons do more than you think.

I also can't read it so no clue why buttons get big.. odd jump if it's switching to a new screen adding a fade or have animation to show something new screen.. would help.

replies.author: Tasty-Concern4582
replies.body: Thanks, bro! I didn’t really understand what you meant by “hover states” at first, since I’m from Spain and English isn’t my first language. But now that I’m tweaking the menu based on everyone’s feedback, I finally get it—and it was actually really good advice.
